name: hanapath-mobile
description: Isolated Capacitor packaging project for the canonical HanaPath web app (see docs/FABLE_MOBILE_PLAY_STORE_HANDOVER.md). The web app itself stays vanilla and build-free; this project only wraps generated, allowlisted copies of the audited assets.

scripts.sync:android: npm run prepare:web && npm run verify:web && capacitor sync android
